title: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Time-Of-Check Time-Of-Use Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Microsoft Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Print Spooler service. By creating a directory junction, an attacker can abuse the Print Spooler service to delete a file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
